title: Oracle shows how structured context turns AI into repeatable work
friendlyTitle: Oracle connects AI to clear business processes
summary: Oracle says more than 130,000 employees actively use ChatGPT and over 95,000 use Codex across recruiting, analytics and engineering. Its examples include a recruiting-research workflow, a business ontology that grounds generated SQL and incident tools that retrieve the right operational playbook.
friendlySummary: Oracle says many employees use ChatGPT and Codex for recruiting, reports and engineering. Its tools connect AI to company rules, data and playbooks.
whyItMatters: The useful lesson is not simply broad access to a chatbot: Oracle paired models with structured organisational knowledge, repeatable workflows and accountable owners. Smaller teams can apply the same pattern to one well-defined process before attempting an organisation-wide rollout; the performance figures remain company-reported.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI becomes more useful when it has trusted information and a clear job. Start with one process and keep a person responsible for the result.
